annotations.title: Ask to give a customer credits

description: Asks the founder to give one Live customer credits: their balance goes up by amount, and note is the line their credit history shows. test_member_credits does the same for a test member in Development, at once. This is a change to one customer, so it is your human's approval alone: they approve it in their browser, and no emailed code is asked. Nothing changes until they approve; approving it carries it out — Gemmein does it the moment they press Approve, once, and records what happened on their Logs. The approval page shows Gemmein's own sentence of the real effect, read against Live; a request that no longer matches Live when it is carried out is refused and nothing changes. Returns the approval link for your human and a handle: live_action_status with wait: true answers the moment it is done, or why not — never ask your human to tell you they approved. A second call asks again (a new approval).

note.description: one line saying why, up to 200 characters — what the customer's credit history shows

person.description: the Live customer: their email address or id (usr_…) — live_people lists them
